meta.basis: Traded = change in bonus/split-adjusted shares x that month's implied price (industry market value / industry shares; within 0.001% of the NSE close). Entries are full purchases, exits full sales, a merger is neither. Value is at that month's price -- the rupees actually deployed.
meta.source: SEBI monthly portfolio disclosures via MFI360; splits/bonuses from NSE's corporate-action feed; stock identity from the NSE bhavcopy lineage.
meta.limits: Share counts start 2016-07. Foreign stocks (US names in international schemes) and unlisted holdings are excluded. QIP/rights subscriptions are real purchases and counted as such; they are not yet labelled.
meta.bucket_rule: Schemes are bucketed by the canonical panel's book_nature x scheme_sub_nature: index_etf = book_nature Index or ETF, or sub-nature Index Funds / ETFs - Others; arbitrage = sub-nature Arbitrage Fund; fof = a fund-of-funds (it holds fund units, so it almost never has direct stock rows); hybrid = book_nature Hybrid (balanced advantage, aggressive hybrid, multi asset, equity savings, conservative, balanced) plus Solution Oriented (retirement, children's), arbitrage excluded; active = every remaining scheme with equity rows (flexi / mid / small / large / large & mid / thematic / multi cap / ELSS / sectoral / focused / value / contra / dividend yield). The buckets are additive: any combination sums to that combination's book.
meta.index_rule: Index = the market-cap band the stock sits in on TODAY's NSE lists: Nifty 50, Next 50, Midcap (NIFTY Midcap 150), Smallcap (NIFTY Smallcap 250), Microcap (NIFTY Microcap 250), or Outside all of them. The five bands do not overlap and between them cover all 747 listed constituents. One snapshot, so an old month is judged against the current list. Every list the stock belongs to -- Nifty 100 / 200 / 500 as well -- is on the row, so the column stays one column.
meta.cap_rule: Cap band = the AMFI large/mid/small tag the vendor stamps on each disclosed holding, taken as the majority of the schemes holding the stock in its LATEST tagged month. It is as of that data month, not today: a stock nobody holds any more carries its last disclosed band and the row says which month that was. No tag in any month = Unclassified, never Small. 35% of stocks have changed band since 2016, so filtering on a band judges an old trade by the stock's current band.
